versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֔ב ק֛וּם עֲלֵ֥ה בֵֽית־אֵ֖ל וְשֶׁב־שָׁ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂה־שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לָאֵל֙ הַנִּרְאֶ֣ה אֵלֶ֔יךָ בְּבָרְחֲךָ֔ מִפְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
controles.kjv: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth–el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
controles.livre: E disse Deus a Jacó: Levanta-te, sobe a Betel, e fica ali; e faze ali um altar ao Deus que te apareceu quando fugias de teu irmão Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־בֵּית֔וֹ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑וֹ הָסִ֜רוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהִֽטַּהֲר֔וּ וְהַחֲלִ֖יפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, change your garments.
controles.kjv: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
controles.livre: Então Jacó disse à sua família e a todos os que com ele estavam: Tirai os deuses alheios que há entre vós, e limpai-vos, e mudai vossas roupas.

versos.hebraico: וְנָק֥וּמָה וְנַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־שָּׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ לָאֵ֞ל הָעֹנֶ֤ה אֹתִי֙ בְּי֣וֹם צָֽרָתִ֔י וַיְהִי֙ עִמָּדִ֔י בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתִּי׃

controles.web: Let us arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
controles.kjv: And let us arise, and go up to Beth–el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
controles.livre: E levantemo-nos, e subamos a Betel; e farei ali altar ao Deus que me respondeu no dia de minha angústia, e foi comigo no caminho que andei.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב אֵ֣ת כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדָ֔ם וְאֶת־הַנְּזָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּטְמֹ֤ן אֹתָם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב תַּ֥חַת הָאֵלָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שְׁכֶֽם׃

controles.web: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
controles.kjv: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
controles.livre: Assim deram a Jacó todos os deuses alheios que havia em poder deles, e os brincos que estavam em suas orelhas; e Jacó os escondeu debaixo de um carvalho, que estava junto a Siquém.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסָּ֑עוּ וַיְהִ֣י׀ חִתַּ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל־הֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א רָֽדְפ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
controles.kjv: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
controles.livre: E partiram-se, e o terror de Deus foi sobre as cidades que havia em seus arredores, e não seguiram atrás dos filhos de Jacó.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב ל֗וּזָה אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן הִ֖וא בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל ה֖וּא וְכָל־הָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
controles.kjv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Beth–el, he and all the people that were with him.
controles.livre: E chegou Jacó a Luz, que está em terra de Canaã, (esta é Betel) ele e todo o povo que com ele estava;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַמָּק֔וֹם אֵ֖ל בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם נִגְל֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּבָרְח֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י אָחִֽיו׃

controles.web: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
controles.kjv: And he built there an altar, and called the place El–beth–el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
controles.livre: E edificou ali um altar, e chamou o lugar El-Betel, porque ali lhe havia aparecido Deus, quando fugia de seu irmão.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּ֤מָת דְּבֹרָה֙ מֵינֶ֣קֶת רִבְקָ֔ה וַתִּקָּבֵ֛ר מִתַּ֥חַת לְבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הָֽאַלּ֑וֹן וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וֹן בָּכֽוּת׃פ

controles.web: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
controles.kjv: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth–el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon–bachuth.
controles.livre: Então morreu Débora, ama de Rebeca, e foi sepultada às raízes de Betel, debaixo de um carvalho: e chamou-se seu nome Alom-Bacute.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹב֙ ע֔וֹד בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
controles.kjv: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan–aram, and blessed him.
controles.livre: E apareceu-se outra vez Deus a Jacó, quando se havia voltado de Padã-Arã, e abençoou-lhe.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים שִׁמְךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לֹֽא־יִקָּרֵא֩ שִׁמְךָ֨ ע֜וֹד יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּ֤י אִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
controles.kjv: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe Deus: Teu nome é Jacó; não se chamará mais teu nome Jacó, mas sim Israel será teu nome: e chamou seu nome Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֲנִ֨י אֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ פְּרֵ֣ה וּרְבֵ֔ה גּ֛וֹי וּקְהַ֥ל גּוֹיִ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑ךָּ וּמְלָכִ֖ים מֵחֲלָצֶ֥יךָ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃

controles.web: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
controles.kjv: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
controles.livre: E disse-lhe Deus: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso: cresce e multiplica-te; uma nação e conjunto de nações procederá de ti, e reis sairão de teus lombos:

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛תִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם וּלְיִצְחָ֖ק לְךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your seed after you will I give the land.”
controles.kjv: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
controles.livre: E a terra que eu dei a Abraão e a Isaque, a darei a ti: e à tua descendência depois de ti darei a terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַל מֵעָלָ֖יו אֱלֹהִ֑ים בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
controles.kjv: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
controles.livre: E foi-se dele Deus, do lugar onde com ele havia falado.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּצֵּ֨ב יַעֲקֹ֜ב מַצֵּבָ֗ה בַּמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ מַצֶּ֣בֶת אָ֑בֶן וַיַּסֵּ֤ךְ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ נֶ֔סֶךְ וַיִּצֹ֥ק עָלֶ֖יהָ שָֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
controles.kjv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
controles.livre: E Jacó erigiu uma coluna no lugar onde havia falado com ele, uma coluna de pedra, e derramou sobre ela libação, e deitou sobre ela azeite.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר אִתּ֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית־אֵֽל׃

controles.web: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
controles.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth–el.
controles.livre: E chamou Jacó o nome daquele lugar onde Deus havia falado com ele, Betel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֵ֔ל וַֽיְהִי־ע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָב֣וֹא אֶפְרָ֑תָה וַתֵּ֥לֶד רָחֵ֖ל וַתְּקַ֥שׁ בְּלִדְתָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
controles.kjv: And they journeyed from Beth–el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
controles.livre: E partiram de Betel, e havia ainda como alguma distância para chegar a Efrata, quando deu à luz Raquel, e houve trabalho em seu parto.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י בְהַקְשֹׁתָ֖הּ בְּלִדְתָּ֑הּ וַתֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֤הּ הַמְיַלֶּ֨דֶת֙ אַל־תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי־גַם־זֶ֥ה לָ֖ךְ בֵּֽן׃

controles.web: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que quando havia trabalho em seu parto, disse-lhe a parteira: Não temas, que também terás este filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֞י בְּצֵ֤את נַפְשָׁהּ֙ כִּ֣י מֵ֔תָה וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן־אוֹנִ֑י וְאָבִ֖יו קָֽרָא־ל֥וֹ בִנְיָמִֽין׃

controles.web: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben–oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que ao sair dela a alma, (pois morreu) chamou seu nome Benoni; mas seu pai o chamou Benjamim.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּ֖מָת רָחֵ֑ל וַתִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔תָה הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (the same is Bethlehem).
controles.kjv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth–lehem.
controles.livre: Assim morreu Raquel, e foi sepultada no caminho de Efrata, a qual é Belém.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּצֵּ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב מַצֵּבָ֖ה עַל־קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ הִ֛וא מַצֶּ֥בֶת קְבֻֽרַת־רָחֵ֖ל עַד־הַיּֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
controles.kjv: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
controles.livre: E pôs Jacó uma coluna sobre sua sepultura: esta é a coluna da sepultura de Raquel até hoje.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסַּ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֣ט אָֽהֳלֹ֔ה מֵהָ֖לְאָה לְמִגְדַּל־עֵֽדֶר׃

controles.web: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
controles.kjv: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
controles.livre: E partiu Israel, e estendeu sua tenda da outra parte de Migdal-Eder.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־בִּלְהָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אָבִ֔יו וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑לפ וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it.   Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
controles.livre: E aconteceu, morando Israel naquela terra, que foi Rúben e dormiu com Bila a concubina de seu pai; o qual chegou a entender Israel. Agora bem, os filhos de Israel foram doze:

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֔ה בְּכ֥וֹר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְשִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבוּלֻֽן׃

controles.web: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
controles.kjv: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Lia: Rúben o primogênito de Jacó, e Simeão, e Levi, e Judá, e Issacar, e Zebulom.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל יוֹסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃

controles.web: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
controles.kjv: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
controles.livre: Os filhos de Raquel: José, e Benjamim.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֤י בִלְהָה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֔ל דָּ֖ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃

controles.web: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s handmaid): Dan and Naphtali.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
controles.livre: E os filhos de Bila, serva de Raquel: Dã, e Naftali.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּד־ל֖וֹ בְּפַדַּ֥ן אֲרָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s handmaid): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan–aram.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Zilpa, serva de Lia: Gade, e Aser. Estes foram os filhos de Jacó, que lhe nasceram em Padã-Arã.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֔יו מַמְרֵ֖א קִרְיַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבַּ֑ע הִ֣וא חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־גָּֽר־שָׁ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְיִצְחָֽק׃

controles.web: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
controles.kjv: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
controles.livre: E veio Jacó a Isaque seu pai a Manre, à cidade de Arba, que é Hebrom, onde habitaram Abraão e Isaque.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ יְמֵ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֖ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
controles.kjv: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
controles.livre: E foram os dias de Isaque cento e oitenta anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע יִצְחָ֤ק וַיָּ֨מָת֙ וַיֵּאָ֣סֶף אֶל־עַמָּ֔יו זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עֵשָׂ֥ו וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב בָּנָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: Isaac gave up the spirit, and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
controles.kjv: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
controles.livre: E expirou Isaque, e morreu, e foi recolhido a seus povos, velho e farto de dias; e sepultaram-no Esaú e Jacó seus filhos.
